name: Droid Bounty Syndicate
backstory: Three hunters share the entry fees and very little else. Precision, mobile pressure and protected support divide the work while the quartermaster upgrades the trio together.
strategy_personality: IG-88 as the precise ranged specialist, IG-11 as the aggressive mobile gunfighter, and 4-LOM as the durable, calculating counterpart. The three builds grow together under Trio's existing purchasing and tuning rules.

robots.name: IG-88
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 85% of square canvas with breathing room. Readable silhouette at 512px.

Subject: Authentic IG-88 bounty-hunter droid, very tall thin battered grey metal body, elongated cylindrical industrial head studded with small sensors, characteristic exposed rods and pistons, narrow torso, source bandolier and spindly limbs. source_notes:
**Franchise:** Star Wars  
**Strategy:** Trio · **Target roster:** 3 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `droid-bounty-syndicate`

**Proposed robots:** IG-88, IG-11, and 4-LOM.

**Identity:** three independent mechanical hunters form an arena collection around precision, relentless pressure, and paid contracts. Their association is proposed for Armoured Souls, not a canonical bounty-hunting team.

**Strategy personality:** IG-88 as the precise ranged specialist, IG-11 as the aggressive mobile gunfighter, and 4-LOM as the durable, calculating counterpart. The three builds grow together under Trio's existing purchasing and tuning rules.

**Visual direction:** IG-88 uses his battered original-trilogy chrome body; IG-11 uses his first-season Mandalorian bounty-hunter form; 4-LOM keeps the rusty protocol-droid body and insect-like head seen in The Empire Strikes Back. Different poses and signature weapon arrangements must distinguish the two IG-series robots. IG-11's picture should depict the mechanical hunter himself rather than an IG-12 configuration carrying Grogu.

References: [IG-88](https://www.starwars.com/databank/ig-88), [IG-11](https://www.starwars.com/databank/ig-11), [4-LOM](https://www.starwars.com/databank/4-LOM).
purchasing_plan: Open with all three robots. Maintain and tune the trio together; complete stage-1 equipment in slot order. No weapon refinement purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
